Improves I2P transport security/PQ-readiness for Bitcoin Core users who run over I2P.

result.summary: This PR changes the I2P SAM session parameters used when creating leasesets from `4,0` (ECIES-X25519, ElGamal) to `6,4` (ML-KEM-768/ECIES-X25519, ECIES-X25519), dropping ElGamal support per the I2P project's current recommendation. It is a two-line change confined to src/i2p.cpp affecting how Bitcoin Core negotiates I2P leasesets.
result.problem: The I2P project now considers ElGamal leaseset encryption legacy and recommends moving to ML-KEM-768/ECIES-X25519, which is relevant to Bitcoin Core's I2P transport users who want stronger, PQ-aware I2P sessions. Without this update, nodes keep using older, weaker encryption types by default.

open_concerns: Whether to use `6,4` (breaks compatibility with pre-#29200/v27 I2P peers whose SAM sessions only support ElGamal) or `6,4,0` (Java I2P does not support 3+ types and will fail sessions), per jonatack and zzzi2p's testing.

Timing: zzzi2p (I2P maintainer) suggests taking this in the next couple releases with a release note rather than immediately; janb84 posted fresh network statistics (2026-08-12) about the ~10% of affected pre-v27 nodes with no author reply since.
resolved_concerns: Missing release note flagged by kevkevinpal was addressed via a separate PR (#35951) proposed by jonatack.
janb84's initial Approach NACK over backward-compatibility breakage was walked back after seeing usage stats ('I'm not that concerned anymore about splitting the network').

categories.rationale: Moves I2P transport off legacy ElGamal toward PQ-aware encryption as recommended by the I2P project (eyedeekay: 'there are good reasons to not use it ... as PQ gets rolled out in I2P, ElGamal will degrade in usability'), but the affected population is narrow: janb84 estimates only ~10% of nodes are pre-v27 and I2P usage itself is a small fraction of the network. zzzi2p, an I2P maintainer, treats the matter as non-urgent ('I wouldn't call it urgent or important. But it should happen at some point').

result.card: This PR updates I2P SAM leaseset encryption parameters from `4,0` (ElGamal + ECIES-X25519) to `6,4` (ML-KEM-768/ECIES-X25519 + ECIES-X25519), following the I2P project's recommendation to retire legacy ElGamal. It matters to Bitcoin Core's I2P transport users' security/PQ posture, but the affected population is narrow: janb84 estimates only about 10% of nodes predate the required v26.1+ I2P support, and I2P itself is a minority transport. The change is small (2 lines) but discussion surfaced a real, unresolved tradeoff: jonatack favors `6,4,0` or waiting for backward compatibility with pre-v27 peers, while I2P maintainer zzzi2p endorses `6,4` as-is and calls the urgency low. The author has not responded since 2026-07-23, leaving both the exact parameter choice and fresh network-impact data (posted 2026-08-12 by janb84) unaddressed. A companion release-note PR (#35951) has been filed to document the change for v32.0.
